newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Zurich Aug securities turnover falls 23.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Zurich Aug securities turnover falls 23.1 pct.

text.p: Securities turnover in the canton of Zurich fell 23.1 pct in August from the month before to 37.21 billion Swiss francs, cantonal bourse authorities said.
Turnover was down 8.6 percent from August of last year.
Cumulative turnover for the first eight months was 42.9 percent higher than last year at 393.68 billion francs.
The figures cover all trade in securities and securities derivatives on and off the bourse and on the Swiss Options and Financial Futures Exchange (Soffex).
